snp3.6:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe.
snp3.6:1.3: Tena kho pana samayena Sabhiyassa paribbājakassa purāṇasālohitāya devatāya pañhā uddiṭṭhā honti:
snp3.6:1.4: "yo te Sabhiya samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā ime pañhe puṭṭho vyākaroti, tassa santike brahmacariyaṃ careyyāsī" ti.
snp3.6:2.1: Atha kho Sabhiyo paribbājako tassā devatāya santike te pañhe uggahetvā, ye te samaṇabrāhmaṇā saṃghino gaṇino gaṇācariyā ñātā yasassino titthakarā sādhusammatā bahujanassa, seyyathīdaṃ:
snp3.6:2.2: Pūraṇo Kassapo Makkhali Gosālo Ajito Kesakambali Pakudho Kaccāyano Sañjayo Belaṭṭhiputto Nigaṇṭho Nātaputto,
snp3.6:2.4: Te Sabhiyena paribbājakena pañhe puṭṭhā na sampāyanti,
snp3.6:2.5: asampāyantā kopañ ca dosañ ca appaccayañ ca pātukaronti,
snp3.6:2.6: api ca Sabhiyañ ñeva paribbājakaṃ paṭipuc chanti.
snp3.6:3.1: Atha kho Sabhiyassa paribbājakassa etad ahosi:
snp3.6:3.2: ‘ye kho te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā saṃghino gaṇino gaṇācariyā ñātā yasassino titthakarā sādhusammatā bahujanassa, seyyathīdaṃ:
snp3.6:3.4: te mayā pañhe puṭṭhā na sampāyanti,
snp3.6:3.5: asampāyantā kopañ ca dosañ ca appaccayañ ca pātukaronti,
snp3.6:3.6: api ca mañ ñev' ettha paṭipucchanti:
snp3.6:3.7: yan nūnāhaṃ hīnāyāvattitvā kāme paribhuñjeyyan' ti.
snp3.6:4.1: Atha kho Sabhiyassa paribbājakassa etad ahosi:
snp3.6:4.2: ‘ayam pi samaṇo Gotamo saṅghī c' eva gaṇī ca gaṇācariyo ca ñāto yasassī titthakaro sādhusammato bahujanassa:
snp3.6:4.3: yan nūnāhaṃ samaṇaṃ Gotamaṃ upasaṃkamitvā ime pañhe puccheyyan' ti.
snp3.6:5.1: Atha kho Sabhiyassa paribbājakassa etad ahosi:
snp3.6:5.2: ‘ye pi kho te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā jiṇṇā vuddhā mahallakā addhagatā vayo anuppattā therā rattaññū cirapabbajitā saṃghino gaṇino gaṇācariyā ñātā yasassino titthakarā sādhusammatā bahujanassa, seyyathīdaṃ:
snp3.6:5.4: te pi mayā pañhe puṭṭhā na sampāyanti,
snp3.6:5.5: asampāyantā kopañ ca dosañ ca appaccayañ ca pātukaronti, api ca mañ ñev' ettha paṭipucchanti,
snp3.6:5.6: kiṃ pana me samaṇo Gotamo ime pañhe puṭṭho vyākarissati,
snp3.6:5.7: samaṇo hi Gotamo daharo c' eva jātiyā navo ca pabbajjāyā' ti.
snp3.6:6.1: Atha kho Sabhiyassa paribbājakassa etad ahosi:
snp3.6:6.2: ‘samaṇo kho ‘daharo' ti na uññātabbo na paribhotabbo,
snp3.6:6.3: daharo pi ce samaṇo hoti, so ca hoti mahiddhiko mahānhubhāvo: yan nūnahaṃ samaṇaṃ Gotamaṃ upasaṃkamitvā ime pañhe puccheyyan' ti.
snp3.6:7.1: Atha kho Sabhiyo paribbājako xyena Rājagahaṃ tena cārikaṃ pakkāmi,
snp3.6:7.2: anupubbena cārikam caramāno yena Rājagahaṃ Veḷuvanaṃ Kalandakanivāpo yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā Bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi,
snp3.6:7.3: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
snp3.6:7.4: Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho Sabhiyo paribbājako Bhagavantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi: 510.

snp3.6:53.1: "Yo kho Sabhiya aññatitthiyapubbo imasmiṃ dhammavinaye ākaṃkhati pabbajjaṃ ākaṃkhati upasampadaṃ, so cattāro māse parivasati, catunnaṃ māsānaṃ accayena āraddhacittā bhikkhū pabbājenti upasampādenti bhikkhubhāvāya,
snp3.6:53.2: api ca m' ettha puggalavemattatā viditā" ti.
snp3.6:54.1: "Sace bhante aññatitthiyapubbā imasmiṃ dhammavinaye ākaṃkhantā pabbajjaṃ ākaṃkhantā upasampadaṃ cattāro māse parivasanti, catunnaṃ māsānaṃ accayena āraddhacittā bhikkhū pabbājenti upasampādenti bhikkhubhāvāya, ahaṃ cattāri vassāni parivasissāmi, catunnaṃ vassānaṃ accayena āraddhacittā bhikkhū pabbājentu upasampādentu bhikkhubhāvāyā" ti.
